_comment: Where durable memory lives. Agentic OS owns routing and learning; the
Obsidian vault owns memory. This file is the only place that knows the
path, so moving the vault is a one-line change rather than a grep.
Ships INERT: vault_root empty means aos vault reports linked:false and
the runtime behaves exactly as it did before. Set vault_root and
project_folder to switch it on. config/ is preserved across updates, so

read._comment: Folders indexed for discovery, in descending authority. A Decision outranks a Gotcha, which outranks a Learning, because that is the order in which they bind.

write._comment: Where `aos learn observe` mirrors an observation. Filename is <date>-<slug>.md, matching the vault's own convention.
